name: NJ-01
label: Safe D

Norcross's huge financial edge: $2.4 million on hand versus about $5,000 for Galdo

model.rationale: Norcross is a well-funded incumbent in a district that leans Democratic by about ten points, in a favorable national environment, and he has raised over $1.6 million while his opponent has raised barely $11,000. Prediction markets price his chances near 96%, and nothing in the record suggests a serious challenge.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a single-digit race, significant outside spending against Norcross, or a major scandal would be the only signals that could move this out of Safe D territory.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.

overview:
Donald Norcross seeks another term in a South Jersey district that has voted Democratic by about ten points in recent cycles. He enters the general election with a decisive financial advantage, holding roughly $2.4 million on hand after raising $1.6 million, while Republican Damon Galdo has raised about $11,000 and has no outside support on either side. No independent groups are spending against the incumbent.

There is no public general-election polling and no expert ratings for this race, so the outlook rests on fundamentals. Prediction markets put Norcross's chances around 96 percent. With the incumbent running, a strong financial position, and a favorable partisan lean, the race is rated Safe Democratic.
